purpose: Central registry for neutral two-rune semantic relationships. This layer records what rune A and rune B mean together before a draw assigns cause/effect positions or directions.

distinction.pair_relation: Unoriented semantic relationship between two runes. No cause/effect role is implied.
distinction.draw_interpretation: A runtime projection that assigns first card = cause and second card = effect, then applies each card direction, question context, moon-phase context and other modifiers.
distinction.loc2_scenario: Real-life scenario evidence that may support a pair relationship, but an Event is not automatically a fixed rune pair.

pair_key_rule: Use an order-neutral key based on ascending rune IDs: minID_maxID. The pair key must remain the same when draw order reverses.
source_policy: Import only explicit two-rune examples supported by source material.
Do not infer a rune pair from an LOC2 Event requirement signature such as SL + ML.
Do not convert a neutral pair relationship into a fixed cause/effect statement.
Keep source provenance per example: syntax_atlas, loc2_scenario, observed_reading, or other verified source.
AI-generated candidate relationships remain proposed until human-confirmed.

runtime_projection.cause_effect_projection: draw card 1 becomes cause; draw card 2 becomes effect
runtime_projection.direction_projection: apply both card directions after the neutral pair relationship is retrieved
runtime_projection.context_projection: apply question / scenario / moon-phase context after pair and direction layers

record_schema_example.relation_summary: Neutral relationship only; not a draw result.

corpus_summary.note: Registry structure is active. Existing repo-searchable LOC2 Event 32 records are scenario prototypes rather than fixed rune pairs. The Destiny Sentence Syntax Atlas is a DOCX binary asset; its explicit pair examples must be extracted without inventing pair mappings.
